capture_limits: Caller can replay by recreating the recorded absolute paths, writing each action's source_bytes/config_text and running its argv with the recorded APT_CONFIG. Output bytes and inputs have SHA256 consistency fields; host authenticity is not attested.

interpretation.add_remove_languages_en: Same target definitions and language setting; source stanza adds DEP-11 and removes Translations.
interpretation.baseline_languages_en: Control run with configured English translations and no deb822 target selectors.
interpretation.causal_comparison: Only the source stanza selector differs between baseline_languages_en and add_remove_languages_en; both use Acquire::Languages en.
interpretation.explicit_reenable_disabled: Explicit Targets: DEP-11 selects a target whose config DefaultEnabled is false.
interpretation.explicit_wildcard_targets: APT's observed wildcard output is captured independently.

isolation: APT_CONFIG uses only a temporary config, one temporary source list, an empty temporary apt.conf.d, and empty temporary lists. Invoked only apt-get indextargets --no-release-info; no update, install, or network acquisition.
